t2.title: It better to live in a big city or a small town
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is it better to live in a big city or a small town?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Great question! As someone who has tried both, I believe coworking spaces are definitely worth it for the right people.

Firstly, the productivity boost is real. At home, distractions are everywhere – household chores, family members, the tempting couch. A dedicated workspace creates mental separation between work and home life.

Moreover, social interaction is invaluable. Working alone can be isolating. Coworking spaces provide community and networking opportunities that may lead to collaborations.

However, cost is a valid concern. Monthly fees can be substantial. For those on tight budgets, working from home might be more practical.

Additionally, if you're self-disciplined and have a quiet home office, you might not need external motivation.

Ultimately, consider your work style and needs. For me, the investment in productivity and wellbeing is worthwhile.

What works best for you?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
WorkHub is good. I like desk. Coffee is good. Price is OK. More coffee maybe?
Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,

WorkHub is good, and I like the desk. The coffee is good too, but it is sometimes busy. The price is okay, but maybe it is too much. I want more coffee and maybe a bigger desk. Thank you.

Bye!
t2.sampleB1:
Dear WorkHub Management,

I am enjoying WorkHub so far. The facilities are mostly good, and the atmosphere is quite productive. I think the price is fair for what you offer, however, there are a few things that could be improved.

For example, it would be great if there were more meeting rooms available. Sometimes it's difficult to find one when I need it. Also, the Wi-Fi can be a bit slow sometimes, which is frustrating. In my opinion, a better coffee machine would also be a good addition!

Overall, I'm happy with WorkHub, and I think it's a good place to work.

Sincerely,
Nodira Rahimova
t2.sampleB2: Ask ten people where they'd rather live, and you'll probably get ten different answers. So which really comes out on top — the buzzing big city or the peaceful small town? City life certainly has its perks. There are endless job opportunities, world-class restaurants and something going on around every corner. If you thrive on energy and want your career to take off, a big city is hard to beat. On the downside, the cost of living can be sky-high, and the constant noise soon takes its toll. Personal space is often a luxury, too. Small towns, meanwhile, offer a slower, friendlier pace. Everybody knows your name, the air is cleaner and you can actually afford a decent home. That said, opportunities can be limited, and you may find yourself bored to tears on a quiet evening. In my opinion, it all boils down to what you value most. If you're chasing excitement, head for the city; if you long for peace and community, a small town wins hands down. Either way, the best place to live is wherever you feel truly at home.
t2.uzSample:
Ajoyib savol! Har ikkalasini ham sinab ko'rgan odam sifatida, menimcha, kovorking maydonlari to'g'ri odamlar uchun albatta arziydi.

Birinchidan, unumdorlikning oshishi haqiqat. Uyda chalg'itadigan narsalar hamma joyda – uy yumushlari, oila a'zolari, jozibali divan. Maxsus ish joyi ish va uy hayoti o'rtasida ruhiy ajralishni yaratadi.

Bundan tashqari, ijtimoiy muloqot juda qimmatli. Yolg'iz ishlash odamni ajratib qo'yishi mumkin. Kovorking maydonlari hamjamiyat va hamkorlikka olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan aloqa o'rnatish imkoniyatlarini taqdim etadi.

Biroq, narx asosli tashvish. Oylik to'lovlar ancha yuqori bo'lishi mumkin. Qattiq byudjetga ega bo'lganlar uchun uyda ishlash amaliyroq bo'lishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, agar siz o'zingizni intizomga soladigan bo'lsangiz va tinch uy ofisingiz bo'lsa, sizga tashqi motivatsiya kerak bo'lmasligi mumkin.

Oxir oqibat, o'z ish uslubingiz va ehtiyojlaringizni ko'rib chiqing. Men uchun unumdorlik va farovonlikka sarmoya kiritish arziydi.

Siz uchun nima eng yaxshi ishlaydi?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
WorkHub yaxshi. Menga stol yoqadi. Kofe yaxshi. Narxi normal. Yana kofe bo'lishi mumkinmi?
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,

WorkHub yaxshi, va menga stol yoqadi. Qahva ham yaxshi, lekin ba'zida gavjum bo'ladi. Narxi yaxshi, lekin balki juda qimmatdir. Men ko'proq qahva va balki kattaroq stol xohlayman. Rahmat.

Xayr!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli WorkHub rahbariyati,

Men WorkHubdan hozircha mamnunman. Qulayliklar asosan yaxshi va muhit juda samarali. Narx siz taklif qilayotgan narsalar uchun adolatli deb o'ylayman, ammo yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta narsa bor.

Misol uchun, agar ko'proq yig'ilish xonalari bo'lsa, juda yaxshi bo'lardi. Ba'zida kerak bo'lganda topish qiyin. Shuningdek, Wi-Fi ba'zan biroz sekin bo'lishi mumkin, bu esa asabiylashadi. Mening fikrimcha, yaxshiroq qahva mashinasi ham yaxshi qo'shimcha bo'lardi!

Umuman olganda, men WorkHubdan mamnunman va bu ishlash uchun yaxshi joy deb o'ylayman.

Hurmat bilan,
Nodira Rahimova
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli WorkHub rahbariyati,

WorkHub Coworkingga a'zo bo'lganimdan beri olgan tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, qulayliklar va diqqatni jamlashga yordam beradigan umumiy muhitdan juda mamnunman. Hozirgi narxlar ko'rsatilayotgan xizmatlarni hisobga olganda, maqbul ko'rinadi, garchi men potentsial yaxshilanishlar uchun bir nechta takliflarga egaman.

Birinchidan, telefon kabinalarida ovoz o'tkazmasligini yaxshilash foydali bo'ladi deb o'ylayman. Ular ma'lum darajada maxfiylikni ta'minlasa-da, muhim qo'ng'iroqlar paytida tashqi shovqin baribir chalg'itishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, katta formatli chop etishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan printerga kirish biz kabi dizayn bilan bog'liq loyihalar ustida ishlayotganlar uchun qimmatli aktiv bo'ladi.

Nihoyat, vaqti-vaqti bilan seminarlar yoki tarmoq tadbirlarini tashkil qilish a'zolar o'rtasida hamjamiyat tuyg'usini yanada rivojlantirishi mumkin. Bu hamkorlik va bilim almashishni rag'batlantirishning ajoyib usuli bo'lishi mumkin.

Takliflarimni ko'rib chiqayotganingiz uchun tashakkur. WorkHubdan foydalanishni davom ettirishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Nodira Rahimova

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who works from home. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I finally joined a coworking space and it's amazing! Working from home was driving me crazy – too many distractions. Now I'm way more productive. You should totally try it! Want to visit with me?
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Islom,
I work new place. It is good. I like it. Work is good here. You come see?
Bye
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Islom,
I am working in a new place. It is a coworking space. I like it very much because it is quiet and I can work. You work at home, but I think you should try my place. It is good for work. Maybe you can visit me there?
See you soon!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Islom,
Guess what? I've started using a coworking space! It's much better than working from home. I was always getting distracted, but now I'm much more focused.

I think you should consider trying one too. You always complain about being lonely at home. A coworking space could help with that, and it might boost your productivity as well. What do you think? Want to come and see it?

Best,
Nodira Rahimova
t11.sampleB2: Hey Islom! Guess what — I've finally started using a coworking space, and honestly it's been a game-changer. Working from home was doing my head in with all the distractions. You should give it a go too; it's brilliant for staying focused. Fancy popping in to check it out? Cheers, Dilnoza
t11.uzSample:
Salom!

Men nihoyat kovorking maydoniga qo'shildim va bu ajoyib!

Uyda ishlash meni aqldan ozdirayozgan edi – juda ko'p chalg'ituvchi omillar bor edi. Hozir men ancha samaraliman.

Sen ham albatta urinib ko'rishing kerak! Men bilan tashrif buyurishni xohlaysanmi?
t11.uzSampleA1:
Salom, Islom,
Men yangi joyda ishlayapman. Bu yaxshi. Menga yoqadi. Bu yerda ish yaxshi. Sen kelib ko'rasanmi?
Xayr
t11.uzSampleA2:
Salom Islom,
Men yangi joyda ishlayapman. Bu kovorking maydoni. Menga juda yoqadi, chunki u yerda tinch va men ishlay olaman. Sen uyda ishlaysan, lekin menimcha sen mening joyimni sinab ko'rishing kerak. Bu ish uchun yaxshi. Balki sen menga u yerga tashrif buyurarsan?

Tez orada ko'rishguncha!
t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom Islom,
Nima deb o'ylaysan? Men kovorking maydonidan foydalanishni boshladim! Uyda ishlashdan ko'ra ancha yaxshi. Men doim chalg'irdim, lekin hozir ancha diqqatliroqman.

Menimcha, sen ham buni sinab ko'rishing kerak. Sen doim uyda yolg'izlikdan shikoyat qilasan. Kovorking maydoni bunga yordam berishi mumkin, shuningdek, unumdorligingni ham oshirishi mumkin. Nima deb o'ylaysan? Kelib ko'rishni xohlaysanmi?

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Nodira Rahimova
t11.uzSampleB2:
Salom Islom,
Ishonmaysan, lekin men nihoyat qaror qabul qilib, kovorking maydoniga qo'shildim. Rostini aytsam, bu juda katta o'zgarish bo'ldi! Uyda ishlash juda ham yolg'izlikka olib keldi va mening unumdorligim jiddiy zarar ko'rdi.

Menimcha, sen ham bu variantni ko'rib chiqishing kerak. Sen ko'pincha motivatsiya bilan kurashayotganing va ish bilan shaxsiy hayot o'rtasidagi chegaralar xiralashayotganini aytasan. Kovorking muhiti senga kerakli tuzilma va ajratishni ta'minlashi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, bu tarmoqlanish va boshqa odamlar bilan fikr almashish uchun juda yaxshi.

Men seni biror vaqt mehmon sifatida olib borishdan xursand bo'lardim, shunda sen buni o'z ko'zing bilan ko'rishing mumkin. Fikringni bildir!

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Nodira Rahimova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the coworking space management. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear WorkHub Management,

Thank you for welcoming me to your community. I am thoroughly enjoying the experience.

Firstly, the facilities are excellent. The high-speed internet, comfortable ergonomic furniture, and professional atmosphere have significantly improved my productivity.

However, I have some suggestions. The meeting rooms are often fully booked. Adding more bookable spaces or a clearer reservation system would help.

Additionally, offering printing services at reasonable rates would be extremely useful for freelancers.

Furthermore, organizing networking events could help members connect and collaborate.

The free coffee is definitely a bonus I appreciate!

Best regards,
A Productive Member
t12.sampleA1:
Hi WorkHub,


I like WorkHub. It is good. The chair is good. Coffee is good. More coffee? Thank you.


Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hello WorkHub,


I like WorkHub. It is nice here. The internet is good and the chairs are good too. But the rooms are busy. Maybe more rooms? And I need to print sometimes, but no printer. Thank you for the coffee, it is good.


Thanks,


Nodira Rahimova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear WorkHub Management,


Thank you for the welcome message. I am enjoying my time at WorkHub so far. The facilities are mostly good. The internet is fast, which is important for my work. I also like the location.


However, I have a few suggestions. I think it would be good if there were more meeting rooms available. It is often difficult to book one when I need it. Also, it would be useful to have a printer that members can use.


In my opinion, the price is fair for what you offer. Thank you for the opportunity to share my thoughts.


Sincerely,
Nodira Rahimova
t12.sampleB2: Dear WorkHub Management, Thank you for the warm welcome. I wanted to share a few thoughts now that I've settled in. On the whole, I've been really impressed. The high-speed internet and comfortable workspaces have made a noticeable difference to my productivity, and the atmosphere strikes the right balance between focused and friendly. I also feel the pricing is fair given everything on offer. That said, I do have a couple of suggestions. The meeting rooms are frequently fully booked, so a clearer reservation system would go a long way. In addition, affordable printing facilities would be a real bonus for freelancers like myself. Overall, I'm delighted with WorkHub and look forward to being part of the community. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli WorkHub rahbariyati,

Meni jamoangizga qabul qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Men bu tajribadan juda mamnunman.

Avvalo, qulayliklar juda yaxshi. Yuqori tezlikdagi internet, qulay ergonomik mebellar va professional muhit mening unumdorligimni sezilarli darajada oshirdi.

Biroq, mening ba'zi takliflarim bor. Uchrashuv xonalari ko'pincha band bo'ladi. Ko'proq bron qilinadigan joylar yoki aniqroq bron qilish tizimini qo'shish yordam beradi.

Bundan tashqari, arzon narxlarda chop etish xizmatlarini taklif qilish frilanserlar uchun juda foydali bo'ladi.

Bundan tashqari, networking tadbirlarini tashkil etish a'zolarga bog'lanish va hamkorlik qilishga yordam berishi mumkin.

Bepul qahva, albatta, men qadrlaydigan bonus!

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Unumdor a'zo

Narx tuzilishi ko'rsatilayotgan xizmatlarni hisobga olgan holda o'rtacha ko'rinadi. WorkHub tajribasini yaxshilashga hissa qo'shish imkoniyatidan minnatdorman.


Hurmat bilan,
Nodira Rahimova
